lane: H78-SPY Liu spy cleaning of the strike-steered learner
why_this_lane_now: H78-TOOTH was the session's first lane and is a completed negative (evidence/h78tooth_negative.json): the gap kernel is anti-aligned with withheld faults (mean gap1 0.118 on truth vs 0.191 on background) and the location-proxy features collapsed the learner onto the mapped traces. The next-ranked unrun hypothesis in research/h78_hypotheses.md is label-noise-robust refitting. This file is the preregistration of that single follow-up, written before the spy refit.
hypothesis: The catalogue is incomplete, so a sample of footprint cells drawn as negatives contains unmapped faults. A strike-steered model trained against those cells is penalised for exactly the signal the live metric pays for. Removing unlabeled cells whose stage-1 score exceeds a threshold set from the labeled positives, then refitting once, raises pooled hide-and-recover DTI relative to the uncleaned model under the same emitter.
mechanism: Stage-1 is the already-fit A2_control (visible catalogue only, seed 20, 450000 negatives, flank_px 2). Let t be the 15th percentile of stage-1 scores on the training positives. Drop training negatives with score >= t, but never more than 20% of the negative sample (if more qualify, drop the highest-scoring 20%). Refit HistGradientBoosting on the same A2 columns and the same positives. No tooth features. No new catalogue-location feature.
mimic_nonfault_process: Lithologic contacts and range-front-parallel drainages also score like faults; dropping them from the negatives makes the refit more willing to mark those non-fault lineaments.
differs_from_this_repo: H78-A is the uncleaned stage-1. H78-MPC did not clean negatives. h20 nnPU (owner-report 0.1890) used a different estimator and a different feature family; this is one Liu-style drop-and-refit on the strike-steered columns.
holdout: same draw and evaluator as H78-A / H78-TOOTH: buffered_component_draw seed 20, gems57-pooled-hide-v2, pooled DTI alpha 0.2 beta 0.8, 300 m, paired 20 km block bootstrap 1000 draws seed 520810, 11321 withheld positives
emitter: greedy max-score, min separation 2.8 px, visible flank <= 3 px, pool 400000, budgets 37654 / 44090 / 50000. Gate uses 44090.
canary: No new feature. Restate single-feature symmetric AUC of the 103 A2 columns on this draw. Any AUC > 0.90 stops the lane.

gates.hypothesis_supported: spy B3@44090 HOLDOUT-DTI > reproduced A2_control 0.1826 AND paired 95% CI lower bound of the difference > 0
gates.uniqueness: abs Spearman <= 0.90 and forward 3 px dot overlap <= 0.70 versus H19-5, D2.8, H33, H78-A primary, H78-A alt B2, H78-MPC, anderson PINN zeros, gems70 dual-submodular, h27-4 solo D2.8, h33d tip/stepover. Surface before placement and final dots. Failure is a duplicate: verdict negative, not OK to submit.
gates.validator: single-band float32, 3730x3292, EPSG:32611, sample transform, all finite, values in [0,1], no NaN, zeros outside the footprint, zero positives on the catalogue, nodata unset
gates.ok_to_submit: all of the above. Agent spends 0 weekly slots.

experiments_charged: This refit is experiment 2 of the session. Experiment 3 is the production build if the gate passes, otherwise a locally validated inspection raster marked NOT OK TO SUBMIT. No third cleaning rate will be tried.
